stages.effectText: When there are 2 or more other Operators within range, ATK +8% (unaffected by skill)

3 Particles orbit Civilight Eterna at all times. When a Particle collides with an allied Operator , it disappears and increases Civilight Eterna's Trait effect on that Operator by 1.6x for 6s, and immediately recovers the Operator's HP equal to 20% of Civilight Eterna's ATK. The disappeared Particle respawns after 6s.
